title: 808 Saints x Van Gammon's New Single "MUD TO MARBLE": A Journey from Rough to Polished
htmlContent:
808 Saints, a rising star in the hip-hop scene, has just released a new single in collaboration with Van Gammon, titled "MUD TO MARBLE." The song takes listeners on a journey of growth and transformation as the beat evolves from rough to polished.

Seshun/Panther City Music Group, the duo behind 808 Saints, has been making beats for six years. Born and raised between California and Texas, their style is heavily influenced by the sounds of both states. Over the years, they have collaborated with several local rappers from Fort Worth and produced their music.

"MUD TO MARBLE" is the first single from 808 Saints in 2023. The name "MUD TO MARBLE" is fitting, representing the growth from being rough around the edges to be more polished. The song features Van Gammon, a fantastic lyricist who helps elaborate the character of the beat.

The song mixes trap, rap, and hip-hop with conscious lyrics that speak to personal growth. The song's mood is moody, epic, and chill, making it a perfect addition to any playlist.

Overall, "MUD TO MARBLE" is a must-listen for anyone who enjoys hip-hop that speaks to personal growth and transformation. With its powerful beats and conscious lyrics, it's sure to become a fan favorite. So turn up the volume and let 808 Saints x Van Gammon's new single take you from rough to polished.
